title: Low-Cal Egyptian Beans
subtitle: with Cucumber Chopped Salad and Crusty Rolls
description: Think eating light means eating boring? Not in our book! Our low-cal recipes have all the punchy flavour and excitement you’d expect from us, and just 450 to 599 calories per serve.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a small saucepan of water to the boil for the eggs. Halve the cucumber lengthwise, then cut into 1cm-thick slices. Halve the tomatoes and quarter any large ones. Thinly slice the onion (see Kitchen notes). Coarsely chop the coriander leaves and finely chop the stems. Crush or finely chop the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.

Make salad and boil eggs: Combine 2 tsp olive oil and 2 tsp red wine vinegar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the cucumber, one-quarter of the tomatoes and half the onion, toss to combine and set aside to marinate. Cook 2 eggs in the pan of boiling water for 6 mins for soft-boiled (see Kitchen notes). Drain, then cool in cold water.

Cook aromatics: Meanwhile, preheat the grill to high. Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the remaining onion, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened. Add the coriander stems, garlic and 3 tsp kofta seasoning and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant.

Simmer beans: Add the remaining tomatoes and 80ml (⅓ cup) water to the onion mixture and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, covered, for 5 mins. Stir in the beans, coriander leaves and 1 tsp honey and cook, covered, for 5 mins or until thickened. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Toast rolls and serve up: While the beans are cooking, cut the bread rolls in half and brush the cut sides with 2 tsp olive oil. Put on an oven tray, cut-side up, and grill for 1-2 mins until lightly toasted. Peel and quarter the eggs. Divide the beans, salad, bread rolls and egg among plates and enjoy!

Kitchen notes: Half the onion will be added to the salad and raw onion can have a strong taste if chunky, so very thinly slice with a sharp knife or use a mandoline if you have one. ~ If you prefer hard-boiled eggs, increase the cooking time to 8 mins.
